heroHeadline: Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour Closes in Brussels at $467.5M — Highest-Grossing Tour Ever by a Latin Artist — After Hailstorm Cuts Milan Short
heroSubtitle: Since the July 14 update, Bad Bunny sold out his first-ever Milan show at Ippodromo SNAI La Maura (July 17, ~80,000 fans), but the second Milan date was cancelled the next night when a violent hailstorm forced an evacuation of the 80,000-capacity venue, injuring several attendees and ending the tour's Italian leg without a reschedule. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour then closed as planned at King Baudouin Stadium in Brussels (July 22), with Jowell & Randy making a surprise appearance. Across 55 shows since its November 21, 2025 launch in Santo Domingo, the tour sold more than 3.1 million tickets and grossed approximately $467.5 million, the highest-grossing tour ever by a Latin artist, and returned Bad Bunny to No. 1 on Billboard's monthly Top Tours chart for a record-extending 10th time. No further tour dates or major announcements have surfaced in the weeks since the Brussels finale.
